ARIA System Documentation

ARIA stands for Agentic Reasoning and Intelligence Architecture.
It is a fully autonomous AI assistant built entirely on free LLM APIs.

Core Features:
ARIA supports web search using Tavily and DuckDuckGo as a fallback.
The document retrieval system uses hybrid search combining dense and sparse methods.
Code execution is sandboxed using RestrictedPython for safety.
Long-term memory persists user preferences and facts across sessions.
The model router automatically switches between providers when rate limits are hit.

Architecture:
The system uses LangGraph for stateful multi-step agent reasoning.
ChromaDB stores vector embeddings for semantic search.
SQLite stores session history, memory metadata, and analytics.
FastAPI serves the backend API on port 8000.
Streamlit provides the chat interface on port 8501.

Supported LLM Providers:
Google AI Studio provides Gemini 1.5 Flash and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
Groq provides LLaMA 3 and DeepSeek Coder models.
Together AI and Cohere serve as additional fallback providers.
